GLM Kotlin port — MIT license option

Upstream: https://github.com/kotlin-graphics/glm
GLM Kotlin port: kotlin-graphics contributors. Based on OpenGL Mathematics by G-Truc Creation.
The upstream README offers MIT or Happy Bunny; the 0.9.9.1-15 Maven POM offers MIT or Apache-2.0.
Cruma selects the MIT option common to both. No separate license file is present in that source JAR.
